verdict.rationale: Motion's own pages describe the core of this story. Prospects can book your time slots instantly from an embedded AI Calendar, and you can create branded meeting links with templates, custom availability windows and pre-meeting questions. Availability comes from your combined Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars, so you are never double-booked, and the calendar becomes unbookable once your daily limits are hit. Missing for 10: in-depth product docs on the booking-link flow (only marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration that invitees see live availability.
